{{Quote|General Kenobi! Sir, the cruiser's returned to orbit.|Captain Rex|<ref name="The Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref>}}
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''''Acclamator''-class assault ship''' was used to transport [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to the surface of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. Shortly after landing, it returned to [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="The Deserter" />
